name: tool-call
purpose: One tool or command the agent invoked, shown in the conversation (AI Elements Tool, Cloudscape progressive steps): a row with the tool name in code font, an optional plain description, and a status (`Waiting`, `Preparing…`, `Running…`, `Completed`, `Failed`, `Canceled`, `Denied`), with the call's input and output in a collapsible panel. It is the record of what the agent did; authorization before it runs is `ToolApproval`.
useWhen: An agent calls a tool, an MCP server, an API or a CLI command during a response, and the reader should see what ran and what came back.
avoidWhen: Asking the reader to allow a call → `tool-approval` (then a `tool-call` records it).
A long-running job outside a chat → `progress` / `status-indicator` on the resource.
related: `tool-approval` — the authorization step before a sensitive call.
`code-block`, `key-value-list` — what goes in the input and output slots.
bestPractices: Name the tool exactly as it is (`list_workloads`) and describe it in plain words (`Listing your workloads`).
Collapse details by default; open them on error so the reader sees why.
Redact secrets from inputs and outputs.

Map an SDK's states: arguments arriving → `streaming`; executing → `running`; awaiting approval → `pending`; result → `success`; failure → `error`; stopped by the reader (outcome cancelled) → `canceled`; approval refused (outcome denied) → `denied`.

props.name: name
props.doc: The tool or command identifier, shown in code font (`list_workloads`).

props.name: title
props.doc: What the call does in the reader's words (`Listing your workloads`). Empty shows only the name.

props.name: status
props.doc: `pending` waits for authorization, `streaming` receives its arguments, `running` is in flight, then `success`, `error`, `canceled` (stopped before it finished) or `denied` (the reader refused it).

props.name: defaultOpen
props.doc: Initial open state when uncontrolled; details start collapsed.

slots.name: input
slots.notes: The parameters the tool is called with (`CodeBlock`, `KeyValueList`).

slots.name: output
slots.notes: What the tool returned, or the error it failed with.
